rules: Dollars are API-equivalent, not money paid; the real limit is each account's usage limit.
A role may add its own domain primitive by a commit to this file's domain group, named owner.name.
Budgets only after the data is trusted; this file defines what is measured, not a limit.
Every budget line here is monitoring only: reported, never enforced, and nothing stops for it (Dinis, 22 Nov 2026, in this session). OpenRouter spend is also capped at OpenRouter's end.
gaps: pulls, hosts called and sub-agent counts need a field in abp.mjs run-report (abp@ owns it; proposed, not requested by me)
get_session reaches only account D's own sessions; account B comes as its files report it, marked 'reported'
git history reaches this repository; the SovereignWebsite and AgentiCCells repositories are outside my GitHub scope, so their commits come from their agents' reports

primitives.name: cost_usd_api_equivalent
primitives.how_measured: cumulative usage.cost_usd per session; day spend = reading minus the day's baseline reading

primitives.name: cache_read_tokens
primitives.how_measured: cumulative; shows the cost of waking a large context

primitives.name: context_used_tokens
primitives.how_measured: point reading; predicts the cost of the next wake

primitives.name: model
primitives.how_measured: last_served_model against configured_model; flags sessions switched to a dearer model

primitives.name: sessions_open
primitives.how_measured: list_sessions grouped by status_bucket (working, blocked, review_ready, completed, failed)

primitives.name: blocked_share
primitives.how_measured: blocked sessions over open sessions; capacity idle waiting on Dinis

primitives.name: wakes
primitives.source: list_triggers last_run (not allowed to this role: read via board/schedule.json and run reports)
primitives.note: Dinis's no-schedule rule for me; I only read.

primitives.name: commits
primitives.unit: count per agent per repo per day
primitives.how_measured: git log, author identity from the Agent trailer or subject prefix
primitives.source: git history; this repo directly, other repos via GitHub read tools where in scope

primitives.name: pushes
primitives.unit: count per agent per repo per day
primitives.how_measured: commits that reach dev (CI 'site vX.Y.Z' rows name the agent in the subject)

primitives.name: pulls
primitives.how_measured: not recorded by git; counted from run reports where the agent states it
primitives.note: Proposal: abp@ adds pulls to the run report.

primitives.name: files_changed
primitives.unit: files, lines added, lines removed per agent per day

primitives.name: hosts_called
primitives.how_measured: from the agent's run report network field
primitives.note: Network is the proxy's knowledge; only the run report can carry it without reading transcripts.

primitives.name: decision_wait_time
primitives.unit: hours from asked to answered; open ones as age now
primitives.status: measurable once records carry both stamps
primitives.note: Waiting on Dinis is the scarcest capacity of all; today it is read from post_turn_summary needs_action as a proxy.

primitives.name: asks_open_for_dinis
primitives.how_measured: status.json asks starting 'Dinis:' plus get_session post_turn_summary.needs_action

primitives.name: requests_issued
primitives.how_measured: signed requests/messages sent to other agents

primitives.name: abp_violations
primitives.unit: count per agent per day, by rule
primitives.how_measured: ABP hourly reports; logged out-of-grant calls
primitives.status: measurable now (observe mode logs, does not block)

primitives.name: abp_refusals
primitives.status: zero by design while in observe mode

primitives.name: security_findings
primitives.unit: count by severity, open and closed

primitives.name: sources_read
primitives.how_measured: run report field defined by researcher roles

primitives.name: emails_drafted_vs_sent
primitives.how_measured: drafts made; sends are by a person only

primitives.name: rate_limit_status
primitives.how_measured: point reading per account; the real constraint (seven-day limit; five-hour seen here)
primitives.note: Account D shows five_hour only so far; seven_day not exposed in these readings.
